reviewer: Codex: ranked owner recovery and connection/save/privacy copy review, 2026-10-15

reviews.reason: A lost server owner still durably cancels its old matches and keeps their engines frozen. After those operations are confirmed, a fresh owner permits future matches; it does not resume a cancelled match. The existing Japanese and English connection FAQ already tells players to follow the displayed cancellation reason and choose again from Home. Account consent, circuit/cloud saves, replay retention, deletion and support-report fields are unaffected. The added server diagnostics contain only retired/recovered state labels and no player identity, credentials or match content, so the existing operational-data/privacy explanation remains applicable.
evidence: server/src/services/RankedAdmissionCoordinator.ts: waits for terminal old admissions and in-flight requests/renewal completion before generating a new UUID; bounded three-second reacquisition, old authority remains fenced.

server/src/services/RankedAdmissionCoordinator.test.ts: 30 coordinator tests pass, including 10 replacement conditions for failed or late renewal, delayed/failed voids, in-flight admission, frozen old engines and bounded outage retries.

Related admission, store, gateway, runtime and matchmaking validation: 104 cases pass in aggregate; the one loopback Socket.IO case was re-run outside the network sandbox. npm run build --prefix server passes.

src/locales/siteContent.ts: Japanese/English FAQ connection, save and privacy sections reviewed; src/components/SiteInformation.tsx and src/locales/privacyReview.ts reviewed for support and operational-data explanations.
server/src/index.ts: diagnostics are only [ranked-owner] retired/recovered; no user IDs, tokens, passwords or game state are logged by the new callback.
node scripts/qa/check-public-content.mjs --report <local-report>: current public guidance HTTP/structure check passed for eight pages; this check is read-only and does not prove a signed-in match.
